requirement: Stable ordered event history with lossless cursor replay

acceptance_evidence: Runtime supervisor enforces proposed caps and blocks AI if task/tenant cost ceilings are unset.; Outer tool calls and internal external steps have separate enforced counters and per-step deadlines.

acceptance_evidence: Record counts, unique names, status labels, release references, JSON and XLSX versions reconcile
